The <b>Slab Keys</b> are [[Items (Silksong)#Keys|items]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They consist of three keys that are obtained separately, all of which are used to open locks in [[the Slab]].

== Use ==
Each of the Slab Keys can be used on specific doors with locks bearing their corresponding marks: 'Indolent', 'Heretic', and 'Apostate'.<ref>Inspecting the lock: <i>"A lock with the mark of 'Indolent'."</i></ref><ref>Inspecting the lock: <i>"A lock with the mark of 'Heretic'."</i></ref><ref>Inspecting the lock: <i>"A lock with the mark of 'Apostate'."</i></ref>

== How to Acquire ==
The three Slab Keys are obtained separately: two are found in [[the Slab]], and the third in the [[Putrified Ducts]]. After acquiring a second key, [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] places the keys together on a keyring.

{| class="article-table"
! style="width: 8rem;" | Item
! Location
! Map
|-
! [[File:Key of Indolent.png|center|72x72px]] Key of Indolent
| 
Found hanging from a chain inside a room in the western part of the Slab. A [[Penitent]] and a [[Puny Penitent]] appear after breaking the key from its chain.
| [[File:Mapshot SS Key of Indolent.png|center|150x150px]]
|-
! [[File:Key of Heretic.png|center|72x72px]] Key of Heretic
| 
Dropped by the final enemy of the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)#The Slab|gauntlet]] in the northwest corner of the Slab.
| [[File:Mapshot SS Key of Heretic.png|center|150x150px]]
|-
! [[File:Key of Apostate.png|center|72x72px]] Key of Apostate
| 
Found in the [[Putrified Ducts]], in an area to the west of [[Huntress]]'s home, next to the corpse of a Wardenfly.
| [[File:Mapshot SS Key of Apostate.png|center|150x150px]]
|}

== Trivia ==
* There is an [[Cut Content (Silksong)/Items#Keys|unused sprite]] in the game files that depicts a keyring with four keys. [[Cut Content (Silksong)/Text#Miscellaneous|Unused text]] suggests the fourth key would have been called "Key of First Sin", presumably used to open the way to [[First Sinner]]'s cell.
* The sprite depicting only Key of Heretic and Key of Apostate is impossible to obtain through normal gameplay, as acquiring Key of Heretic requires Key of Indolent. However, if they are obtained together through other means, the game will still use the combined sprite and update their item description accordingly.
